RTFExporter
Table of Contents

Namespace RTFExporter

Classes

Color

Represents an RGB color used within an RTF document's color table (\colortbl).

Margin

Represents document margins (left, right, top, bottom) in current document measurement units.

RTFDocument

Represents a Rich Text Format (RTF) document. Acts as the root container for paragraphs, color tables, font tables, and document metadata.

RTFParagraph

Represents a structural paragraph block inside an RTF document (\par). Contains a collection of text segments and paragraph-level styling.

RTFParagraphStyle

Represents paragraph-level styling configuration including alignment, indentation, and vertical spacing.

RTFParser

Provides static serialization methods to transform an in-memory RTFDocument into raw RTF text syntax or directly save to disk.

RTFText

Represents a contiguous run of formatted text within an RTFParagraph. Every RTFText instance holds its raw string content and character-level style.

RTFTextStyle

Represents character-level styling options for text runs inside an RTF document.

Structs

Indent

Represents horizontal indentation settings for a paragraph within an RTF document.

Enums

Alignment

Specifies horizontal text alignment for paragraphs inside an RTF document.

Orientation

Specifies the page orientation of an RTF document.

Underline

Specifies the style of underline applied to an RTF text run.

Units

Specifies the measurement units used for document dimensions, margins, and paragraph spacing.
